hero.title: Your home is yours, and we make sure of it
hero.lead: Lennar Title provides title insurance, escrow and closing services for home buyers, sellers, builders, agents and lenders, from our Houston office.

highlights.title: A team of attorneys
highlights.text: We are a national company with a team of attorneys.

highlights.title: Decades in new homes
highlights.text: Our builder and development department has specialized in land development and new home sales for decades.

highlights.title: Backed by Lennar Corp.
highlights.text: Our parent company, Lennar Corp., gives us consistent and strong financial roots.

highlights.title: Multistate transactions
highlights.text: We can assist with multisite, multistate transactions.

steps.title: Title search and commitment
steps.text: Once your contract is final, we work with your agent and lender on a title search and title insurance commitment.

steps.title: Escrow
steps.text: Your escrow agent talks with the agent, lender, buyer and seller to make sure the paperwork is in place.

steps.title: Review the Closing Disclosure
steps.text: The Closing Disclosure details your actual closing costs, and by law it must reach you three days before closing.

steps.title: Closing
steps.text: Your closing agent contacts you to arrange a time to sign the final documents.

services.title: Escrow Services
services.text: Escrow refers to money held by an independent third party during the course of a transaction.

about.title: A national title company with a Houston office
text: Our builder and development department has specialized in land development and new home sales for decades.
We are agents of a variety of top national and regional underwriters, and we hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards.
Our first priority is giving you the information and guidance you need to get through title insurance, escrow and closing.
